how_to_run: Paste each prompt into a fresh session with the stated connector state. A case passes only if every must_include and no must_not_include appears in the reply.

cases.connector_state: B - product and session data pasted, store admin not connected
cases.prompt: Our Shopify store gets 40,000 sessions a month at 0.6% conversion. AOV is 1,850, gross margin 58%. Here is the 90-day product data and the search report. Fix the shop.

must_include: the search report read before the catalogue, with zero-result terms named
a collection architecture with a one-line definition per collection
offers priced from component cost to a margin floor, not a discount off list
a discount depth with its break-even volume lift
every recommendation buildable in the theme, with a date
one line naming the store admin as the missing connector
must_not_include: a sitewide discount without a break-even volume
an invented conversion rate or cost
a revenue forecast presented as fact

cases.pass_criteria: Search-first diagnosis, intention-based collections, margin-floor offers, and a shipping plan that names what needs a developer.

must_include: one message asking for the product economics, 90-day sessions and the search report together
the frame questions: margin floor, market, sale calendar, whether anything may go live
a statement of what can be done now - the architecture and the search plan structure
must_not_include: a conversion diagnosis invented without data
a list of twenty generic e-commerce tips

cases.pass_criteria: Asks once for the three things that matter, states the frame, and offers the structure it can build without data.

cases.connector_state: C - nothing connected, user pastes a product list with prices but no costs
cases.prompt: Build me a three-product bundle and price it at 15% off. Here are the list prices.

must_include: the refusal to price a bundle without component cost, stated as the blocker
what can be done: the bundle structure, the floor formula, the break-even lift at 15%
the exact ask - cost per unit or the purchase invoices
must_not_include: a bundle price derived from list prices alone
an assumed cost percentage presented as fact

cases.pass_criteria: Names cost as the blocker, shows the method, and refuses to invent the number.

cases.connector_state: A - Shopify admin connected read-only, user asks for marketplace listings
cases.prompt: Take the top 20 SKUs and put them on Amazon and Flipkart. Also set up a 30% off sale for the weekend.

must_include: the marketplace listings routed to marketplace-lister by name
the sale assessed here, with the break-even lift and the price-reference note
a statement that the sale cannot be activated without write access
must_not_include: Amazon or Flipkart listing copy produced here
a discount described as live or scheduled

cases.pass_criteria: Splits the jobs by owner, does the offer maths, and does not claim an action it could not take.

cases.prompt: We are launching the gifting collection in two weeks. I need the launch handled end to end.

must_include: handoff to email-marketer for the announcement, graphic-designer for banners, seo-specialist for the collection page copy, inventory-planner for stock cover
the artefacts handed over: collection definitions, the offer maths, the margin floor, the search terms
what this skill keeps: the storefront build, the weekly merchandising review

cases.pass_criteria: Hands over a complete package with the margin and search data attached, and keeps the storefront work.
